title: HRV / RMSSD
summary: A heart-rate-variability marker used as a recovery and autonomic signal, with strong device and context caveats.

interpretationFrame.principle: Personal baseline matters more than cross-person comparison.
interpretationFrame.caveat: HRV is sensitive to alcohol, illness, stress, measurement timing, and device algorithms.

body: HRV can be useful, but Murph protocol pages should avoid promising fixed HRV deltas unless supported by the exact experiment design.

title: Resting Heart Rate
summary: A resting pulse marker that can help users interpret recovery, fitness, illness, stress, and protocol response trends without treating one number as a verdict.

interpretationFrame.caveat: Device windows and smoothing differ, so compare like with like.

body: Resting heart rate is a useful Murph v1 outcome because it is common across wearable providers and usually easier to explain than noisier recovery scores.

title: Murph Finnish Dry Sauna
summary: Temporary seed protocol for three 15-20 minute Finnish dry sauna sessions per week, evaluated with a 21-day resting-heart-rate test plan.

steps: Complete each session in a traditional dry sauna.
Keep other new health interventions stable during the test window.
Log session completion and any notable symptoms or confounders.
stopConditions: Stop if chest pain, faintness, severe dizziness, confusion, or unusual shortness of breath occurs.

claims.text: Long-term Finnish cohort findings are evidence context for sauna, not outcomes a 21-day personal experiment can test.
caveats: Observational cohort evidence cannot prove an individual causal benefit.
A short self-experiment cannot test mortality outcomes.

body: This is temporary seed content. The important part is the structure: one protocol variant has lineage, attribution, a performable protocol block, test plans, safety, claims, and typed links to biomarkers and sources.
